pages.title: Go
pages.text: A rail item denotes the "go" action.$(br2)Filters in item or block foci denote blocks towards which the mob will try to navigate.$(br2)An empty block focus denotes that focus's position in the world.
This action will only begin so long as there's a viable target block in range.$(br2)It succeeds if it reaches its target block, and fails if its target block is removed or becomes inaccessible.
